detailedOverview: SPES Swiftpace delivers construction management support centered around critical-path sequencing, site coordination, contractor accountability, and financial transparency. We act as the client’s authoritative technical representative, coordinating consultants, trade contractors, and suppliers to eliminate budget leakages and project delays.
capabilities: Critical Path Method (CPM) project scheduling and baseline tracking
Comprehensive procurement strategy and material supply chain management
Contract administration, contractor prequalification, and tender evaluation
On-site quality control (QC), materials testing, and craftsmanship verification
Occupational Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) site compliance enforcement
Cost control, bill of quantities (BOQ) valuation, and milestone payment certification
Regular client photographic progress logs and digital dashboard reporting

clientBenefits.title: Uncompromising Quality

clientBenefits.title: Total Stakeholder Transparency

processStages.title: Project Charter & Work Breakdown
processStages.desc: Establishing scope boundaries, timeline milestones, budget allocations, and RACI matrices.

processStages.title: Tendering & Contractor Selection
processStages.desc: Preparing tender documents, evaluating subcontractor bids, and structuring contract terms.

processStages.title: Site Execution & Coordination
processStages.desc: Daily coordination of site meetings, labor allocation, and trade sequencing.

processStages.title: Quality & Safety Audits
processStages.desc: Inspecting materials, verifying slump tests, and enforcing mandatory safety protocols.

processStages.title: Financial Valuation & Claims
processStages.desc: Measuring work done, verifying variation orders, and issuing milestone valuation certificates.

processStages.title: Commissioning & Project Closeout
processStages.desc: Comprehensive defect rectification, final account reconciliation, and handover.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a building contractor and a construction manager?
faqs.a: A contractor is hired to execute specific physical works. A construction manager acts on behalf of the client to oversee, schedule, cost-manage, and quality-audit contractors, ensuring the client’s financial and quality interests are strictly protected.

faqs.q: Can SPES manage a project for clients based outside Ekiti or abroad in the diaspora?
faqs.a: Yes. A substantial part of our clientele includes diaspora property owners and corporate organizations who rely on our transparent milestone reports, video walkthroughs, and verified bank certificate disbursements.
